title: Nutrient Deficiency — South Block
description: Multiple trees in the south block show severe yellowing and stunted growth patterns consistent with nitrogen and potassium deficiency. Soil testing recommended.
recommendations: Conduct comprehensive soil nutrient analysis
Apply targeted NPK fertilizer treatment
Schedule follow-up inspection in 30 days
Consider foliar spray for immediate nutrient uptake

title: Irrigation System Check — West Section
description: Trees in the western risky zone show uneven moisture stress. The drip irrigation system may have blockages or pressure inconsistencies affecting water distribution.
recommendations: Inspect drip irrigation lines for blockages
Check water pressure at distribution points
Install soil moisture sensors at 3 monitoring stations
Adjust irrigation schedule based on findings

title: Canopy Health Report — Northeast Block
description: Routine canopy assessment confirms healthy growth patterns in the northeast block. All trees show adequate frond development and fruit bunch formation.
recommendations: Continue standard maintenance schedule
Plan next routine inspection in 60 days
Document growth rates for yield forecasting

title: Ganoderma Alert — South Block
description: Confirmed Ganoderma boninense infection on tree T016. Adjacent trees T014 and T018 also show early symptoms. Immediate containment measures required to prevent spread.
recommendations: Isolate infected trees with soil trenching
Apply hexaconazole fungicide treatment
Remove and destroy severely infected tree T018
Monitor adjacent trees bi-weekly for 3 months
Consider replanting with disease-resistant cultivar

title: Pest Monitoring — West Section
description: Rhinoceros beetle damage observed on lower fronds of several trees in the western section. Damage is currently moderate but could escalate without intervention.
recommendations: Deploy pheromone traps at 50m intervals
Apply Metarhizium anisopliae biological control
Clear decaying organic matter to remove breeding sites
Schedule weekly monitoring rounds
